**Living Crucible (Su):** Your body has been hardened by long exposure to intense energy, and you can add more raw energy to cleanse it of toxins. At 2nd level, you can consume a bomb as a standard action. Rather than damaging you, the bomb gives you a bonus on saving throws against cold effects and diseases for 1 round. If you have already contracted a disease, the bonus applies on your next saving throw against that disease even if it doesn't take place during that round. The bonus is equal to your poison resistance bonus.

This ability replaces poison use and alters poison resistance.

**Purge Spell (Sp):** At 6th level, when you use living crucible, the bonus also applies against all spells.

This ability replaces swift poisoning.

**Purge Frailty (Su):** At 16th level, you no longer age and cannot be magically aged. In addition, when you use living crucible, the bonus applies to negative energy effects, death effects, and effects that penalize, damage, or drain your ability scores.
